title: Rust Announce signing omits canonical domain-separated transcript and app length
description: Rust lichen-core Announce::write_signed_data and lichen-node scheduler/tests still construct legacy IID||pubkey||seq||channel||app transcripts. Canonical cross-implementation transcript is LICHEN-ANNOUNCE-v1\0 || IID8 || pubkey32 || seq_u16be || rx_channel_u8 || app_len_u16be || app. Legacy signing permits cross-protocol ambiguity and fails stabilized announce_signed_data.json vectors. Update production builders/verifiers and vector tests consistently.
close_reason: Production paths were already canonical (committed lichen-core write_announce_signed_data builds LICHEN-ANNOUNCE-v1\0||IID8||pubkey32||seq_u16be||rx_channel_u8||app_len_u16be||app; verified byte-identical to python/src/lichen/announce/messages.py signed_data()). Canonical-only verification, no legacy accept path (mirrors Python). Added 8 tests in rust/lichen-node/src/announce.rs: 4 hardcoded JSON vector literals through production codec+verifier, processor acceptance of hardcoded frame, and negatives (wrong domain, wrong app_len, truncated app, seq endianness flip, legacy transcript layout; processor-level legacy-signature rejection). cargo test -p lichen-node --lib announce: 33 passed; full -p lichen-node: 274+integration passed except PRE-EXISTING secure.rs blockwise failure (reproves at HEAD); lichen-core all green; clippy clean for announce.rs; rustfmt clean.
